items.name: Yutta
items.text: The tank top is exceptionally comfortable, you don’t remember you have it on, l even sleep in mine. I highly recommend it.

items.name: Carol
items.text: I Love the comfort and gentle support. I had just bought some new bras in the spring; now I need to donate!

items.name: Eileen
items.text: Light weight,stayed put. After 3 washes,cups are still in place. Very satisfied!

items.name: Becki
items.text: I was skeptical when I ordered the tanks because I have tried different cami' and bras and nothing fit well or was comfortable. Glad I found these because they are super comfortable and give me a reasonable amount of support. I would recommend highly

items.name: Cathy
items.text: The tank is extremely comfortable giving support without feeling tight at all. I can wear it all day.

items.name: Annmarie
items.text: Perfect fit! The shelf less bra stays in place and the tank top is very comfortable. It’s an easy top for layering or to wear underneath sweaters. Thank you!

items.name: Heather Kurtin
items.text: So soft and comfortable, washes like a dream, holds it shape, doesn’t feel like wearing anything but gives good support

items.name: Laurel
items.text: This is one of the best fitting tank tops. It has started to get a bit chilly and I love it hugging me and adding some warmth to my torso. The support is great for everyday (not running ect) and I am a size ‘c’. I bought 2 and I am definitely buying more. I also love the soft material,

items.name: Diane
items.text: This is every bit as good as I had hoped. Very comfortable support without feeling tight or constricting.

items.name: Esskaye
items.text: So comfortable, and the support is good.! I am a DD cup and I have no qualms about wearing this tank when I’m out and about.

items.name: Victoria
items.text: I’m 74 years old and this is the first time I’ve ever had a comfortable bra

items.name: Barb
items.text: Super comfortable! It's also very light so im not even aware that I'm wearing it.
